packageRules.description: pnpm is pinned in both mise.toml and packageManager; bump them in one PR.
uuid 12+ is ESM-only; pouchdb require()s it. The override only exists for pnpm audit (see docs/toolchain.md).
The minimatch override breaks multimatch 6, which web-ext default-imports; multimatch 8 fixes that. CI never runs web-ext, so hold both majors (see docs/toolchain.md).
Paired with the minimatch rule above.
